name: Alina
site: o2.de · Mobile and home internet, Germany
headline: Turn o2’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile tariffs, smartphones with contracts, home internet and unlimited deals to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive for an iPhone 17 Pro or for fibre at home.
The signal you already own is what customers use: data volumes, roaming trips, streaming and TV, which line runs out first. That signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The mobile tariff customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Per customer churn signals from data usage, contract end dates and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment for each mobile and home internet customer, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next upgrade when it fits
cases.text: Next best tariff, device or add-on for each customer, such as fibre for a mobile-only household. No more blanket mails to customers already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep the service in use, every week
cases.text: Personal nudges for TV, streaming and roaming, sent by push and email, so each customer sees a reason to use their plan again. Orchestrated per customer, not per campaign.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
